Rachel / Marissa — quick technical note from infra/marketplace side: we can definitely map usage so a single SKU aggregates across the dedicated capacity and autoscale bursts. Implementation details:

- Create two SKUs in Marketplace: RBW-BRIGHT-CORE-18 (committed vCPU-hours equivalent) and RBW-BRIGHT-BURST-6 (short-term burst).
- Usage will be reported as aggregated SKU usage per month; AWS will generate one invoice line per SKU in the Marketplace billing export. That meets Brightline’s ledger mapping ask.
- For reconciliation we’ll include a monthly CSV usage report (usage_by_sku_YYYYMM.csv) that finance can attach to AP.

One caveat: if Brightline requires per-region line items we may need to expand SKUs (adds complexity). If they’re OK with a single consolidated SKU per offer, that’s simplest.

Marissa — I’ll need SKU unit numbers you want committed for the core so I can wire them to the marketplace private-offer creation flow.

— Dev
